clips.title: The story
paras: Rane Yorick seeks help in Silverpine Forest as her brother Quinn lies badly wounded. She needs discolored worg hearts for Apothecary Renferrel at the Sepulcher, whose alchemy may help Quinn recover.

Rane Yorick stays beside her severely wounded brother, Quinn, after the Deathstalkers' disastrous mission left them pinned down at a farm in northern Silverpine. The feral ghoul Ivar the Foul mauled Quinn, and he is failing to recover. Ordinary rest cannot mend an undead body torn by such savagery. Rane turns to the Royal Apothecary Society and its grim arts for a way to put her brother back together.

The worgs of Silverpine carry the corruption spreading through northern Lordaeron. Their hearts are discolored and hold potent essences. The Royal Apothecaries can distill these blighted organs into concoctions that restore withered Forsaken flesh.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: My brother Quinn was badly hurt by the ghoul, Ivar the Foul, and I don't know if he will heal properly without alchemical aid. Although I am not an apothecary, I do know that our apothecaries can make healing potions from the discolored hearts of worgs.
Gather such hearts and take them to Apothecary Renferrel at the Sepulcher to the south. Then return here with the potion.
You can find plenty of worgs between here and Malden's Orchard to the east.

clips.title: Progress
paras: My time is short, adventurer, for the Dark Lady has charged me with a grave task.

clips.title: Completion
paras: It is troubling to hear our Deathstalkers have failed their mission.
Let us hope that these failures are rare.
I'll give you the potion in a moment.
